```powershell
Write-Output '=== SLAB COLLISION GEOMETRY CENSUS - THE ONE UNREAD VALUE, BOTH PROJECTS (Job 324 settled the pawn: her C++ capsule is healthy, InitCapsuleSize 42/96, real CharacterMovement - the borrowed seats capsule theory is closed. Job 324s log read also proved the 321/322 ground repair scripts EXECUTED successfully in both projects - yet OMNI recooked after its repair in 322 and the pawn STILL fell from spawn. So the open value is no longer the slab actors component settings, which the repair set and saved: it is the slab MESHs own collision GEOMETRY - its BodySetup trace flag and whether any simple collision shapes exist at all. A component can be QueryAndPhysics on BlockAll and still collide with nothing if the mesh carries no collision shapes. This job reads exactly that, plus the PlayerStart position against the slab, with the file-write capture that worked in 326/327. READ-ONLY.) ==='
foreach ($g in @(@('VEIL','D:\VEIL','VEILDistrict'), @('OMNI','D:\OMNI-UE','OMNIWorld'))) {
  $name = $g[0]; $proj = $g[1]; $mapname = $g[2]
  "##### $name #####" | Write-Output
  $umap = Get-ChildItem "$proj\Content" -Recurse -Filter "$mapname.umap" -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1
  if (-not $umap) { Write-Output "MAP NOT FOUND: $mapname"; continue }
  $rel = $umap.FullName.Substring(("$proj\Content").Length).Replace('\','/'); $gpath = '/Game' + $rel.Replace('.umap','')
  Set-Content "$proj\Saved\phi_mappath.txt" -Value $gpath -Encoding ASCII
  $py = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([System.Convert]::FromBase64String(''))
  $py = $py.Replace('MAPPATHFILE', "'$proj\Saved\phi_mappath.txt'").Replace('OUTFILE', "'$proj\Saved\phi_slab_census_out.txt'")
  Set-Content "$proj\Saved\phi_slab_census.py" -Value $py -Encoding UTF8
  Remove-Item "$proj\Saved\phi_slab_census_out.txt" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  $cmdexe = 'C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.8\Engine\Binaries\Win64\UnrealEditor-Cmd.exe'
  $uproj = Get-ChildItem $proj -Filter '*.uproject' -File | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName
  & $cmdexe $uproj -run=pythonscript -script="$proj\Saved\phi_slab_census.py" -unattended -nopause -nosplash *> "$proj\Saved\slabcensus328.log"
  if (Test-Path "$proj\Saved\phi_slab_census_out.txt") { Get-Content "$proj\Saved\phi_slab_census_out.txt" | Write-Output } else { Write-Output 'NO SLAB CENSUS OUTPUT FILE' }
}
Write-Output 'SLAB CENSUS DONE'
```
